crossRefs.note: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for…
Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people…
God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear…
Now king Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites…
The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel; that so you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: Above all, may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
translations.asv: Only Jehovah give thee discretion and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel; that so thou mayest keep the law of Jehovah thy God.
